/.title: My Framer Site
p: Built by two sailors. Used by cruisers, racers, instructors and crew in every corner of the map.
Sailors kept asking us where to sail next.
So we built SailTies Adventures - a curated selection of sailing trips, chosen by us, that we'd want to go on ourselves.
Press record. That's your part done.
SailTies tracks the passage while you sail it: distance, duration, speed and the conditions you had. Add crew, add photos as you go, and it's filed by the time you're tied up.
“It's become a routine to start SailTies as soon as I start rigging the boat.”
Every voyage keeps its map, its photos, the anchorage you'd go back to and the people who were aboard. Replay the passage, share a postcard from the day, or scroll back through a whole season.
“It is such a great bank of memories from sailing.”
Add crew to a voyage and they get their miles too. Start a group for your club or your regular crew, see where friends have been sailing, and find sailors near you.
You don't need your own boat to sail more.
Post a place on your next passage or find one going out. Every sailor on SailTies has a logged history behind them, so you can see who you'd be sailing with before you say yes.
Let them follow you from the kitchen table.
Share a live link and family can watch the passage as it happens. No app, no account. They open the link and see where you are.
“The need for a simple log and a way for my family to track me while sailing.”
Your miles add up to something.

Sea time, passages, boats sailed and qualifications, kept in one place and exported as a sailing CV. Used by sailors building toward RYA, ASA, IYT, NauticEd and USCG tickets, and by crew applying for berths.
However you record it, it ends up here.
“A season of Solent trips I'd otherwise have forgotten by November.”
Group a season, a course or a regatta into one story, with a replay of the whole thing.
Every ocean you've crossed, as a heatmap.
The wind and sea you actually sailed in, added automatically.
Colour-coded fastest and slowest stretches, and your best runs kept.

SailTies Adventures is a small collection of trips you can book a place on training weeks, expeditions, races and cruises. Every one is chosen by sailors who know the boats and the people running them.
It started because sailors here kept asking where to go next.
The all-in-one app that logs your voyages, finds your crew, and gets you out on the water.
Create a free website with Framer, the website builder loved by startups, designers and agencies.
